metrics.investment_case_interpretation: 折后可分配现金利润为正，但市值/折后可持续可分配现金利润约18.5年，超过 profit_cheap 的15年入门线；同时折后可剥离净现金高于粗筛市值，分类应看清算/净现金覆盖而非利润便宜。

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: RMB-denominated group cash; annual report does not split listed parent/offshore versus Mainland operating subsidiaries, RMB not freely convertible, so use only-known-group-cash/Mainland conservative range.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash at bank, cash on hand and short-term deposits under 3 months; detachable only after keeping operating cash separately.

cash_breakdown.item: Time deposits with maturity over three months
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Term deposits are cash-like but no exact maturity split beyond over three months; RMB Mainland convertibility and distribution path uncertain.
cash_breakdown.reason: Bank time deposits over three months from Note 25.

cash_breakdown.item: Wealth management products classified at FVPL
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Principal-protected but no predetermined return and measured at FVPL; treat as structured wealth management rather than cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Current FVPL wealth management products, expected yield 1.62%.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Performance security deposits are restricted and not detachable without affecting obligations.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 25 identifies restricted bank balances as performance security cash deposits.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Non-current unlisted limited partnership interests; executive partners control decisions and liquidity is not cash-like.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 21 describes Liaoning Qisheng, Nanjing Maoxing and Shanghai Tianji partnerships.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Acquisition settlement receivable rather than freely distributable cash; not included in primary detachable pool.
cash_breakdown.reason: FVPL contingent consideration receivables from acquisitions.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing RMB bank borrowing is deducted at 100%.
Estimated about one month of cash operating cost to maintain property management payroll, suppliers and project operations amid receivable volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: Revenue RMB7.88bn and cash operating cost base imply roughly RMB0.6bn monthly cash need; not directly disclosed.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and distribution friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: RMB cash is largely Mainland-denominated and not freely convertible; leave a reserve for tax, FX and dividend friction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Note 25 RMB convertibility disclosure and lack of parent/subsidiary cash split.

profit_quality.assessment: Use RMB100m pre-haircut distributable cash profit, close to 2025 parent net profit RMB103.3m and 2025 operating free cash flow after PPE/intangible purchases RMB98.4m; do not use RMB524.3m core net profit because it adds back bad debt provisions that reflect real collection risk in this sector. Apply 0.50 haircut because receivables increased RMB1.053bn, financial asset impairments were RMB399.6m, and 2025 OCF benefited from other operating asset release.
adjustments: Excluded finance income on bank deposits RMB23.383m and FVPL fair value gain RMB28.583m from sustainable cash profit to avoid double counting returns on funds assets considered in detachable cash.
Did not add back financial asset impairment in full; property manager receivables from developers/government and aged receivables are a cash collection issue, not a harmless accounting charge.
Capital expenditure considered using 2025 payments for PPE RMB313.392m and intangible assets RMB609.322m; exact maintenance/growth split unavailable, so the final profit haircut remains conservative.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2025 operating cash flow RMB1.021bn less PPE/intangible purchases RMB0.923bn leaves about RMB98m; 2024 comparable was negative after capex.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Recent turnaround, bad-debt-heavy profit bridge, large receivable build and uncertain maintenance capex split justify a 0.50 cash-profit haircut.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Accounting profit converted to operating cash in 2025, but the bridge depends on other operating assets release while trade receivables continued to grow.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex not separately disclosed; 2025 PPE and intangible cash purchases were high, so no uplift to profit quality.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Receivables and ECL are the main cash conversion constraint.
